# Shader

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Graphics` · class

```csharp
public sealed class Shader : IContent
```

Types: [`IContent`](IContent.md)

A custom way to draw sprites, compiled by the content pipeline from Slang. Load it from content, and begin a batch with it.

## Methods

### GetParameter

```csharp
public ShaderParameter GetParameter(string name)
```

Types: [`ShaderParameter`](ShaderParameter.md)

Gets a handle to a named shader uniform parameter.

| Parameter | |
|---|---|
| `name` | The name of the uniform parameter in the shader source. |

**Returns:** A [`ShaderParameter`](ShaderParameter.md) handle that can be used to set the parameter value.

The returned [`ShaderParameter`](ShaderParameter.md) is a lightweight handle and does not own resources independently. Its lifetime is tied to this `Shader` instance; disposing the shader invalidates all associated parameter handles.
